name: dev.resaleiq/resaleiq
title: Resale IQ
description: Reseller tools: Vinted item check, marketplace fees, profit, max buy price, lot and shipping costs.

tools.name: check_vinted_item
tools.description: For a second-hand item named by brand and model (for example "Adidas Samba" or "Stone Island hoodie"), return BUY, WATCH or SKIP for resellers, the typical asking price range on Vinted and the most to pay when sourcing it. From live Vinted asking prices and watched departures across Spain, France, Germany, Italy and Portugal. Asking prices, not confirmed sale prices. Says plainly when the brand is not tracked. A limited number of free checks a day per connection.

query.description: Brand and model, an item title, or a Vinted item URL

market.description: Optional Vinted country to read: es, fr, de, it or pt. Leave out for the five combined.

tools.name: calculate_resale_fees
tools.description: Work out the selling fees, the payout and the profit of one sale on a resale marketplace (eBay US/UK/DE/FR/IT/ES/AU/CA, Vinted EU/UK, Depop, Poshmark, Mercari, Etsy, Grailed, Vestiaire Collective, Whatnot, Kleinanzeigen), from the platform's published fee schedule. On eBay UK, DE, FR, IT and AU and on Kleinanzeigen that is the private-seller schedule: business sellers pay other fees, and the answer says so. Returns each fee line, total fees, net payout, profit, margin and the lowest sale price that breaks even, with the date the fees were read and the official source. Amounts are in the platform's own currency.

sale_price.description: Price the item sells for, in the platform's currency

item_cost.description: What you paid for the item (default 0)

shipping_charged.description: Shipping the buyer pays to you (default 0; 0 when the platform bills the buyer directly, as on Vinted)

shipping_paid.description: What you pay for the label (default 0)

promoted_pct.description: Promoted or boosted listing rate in % (default 0)

international.description: International sale, where the platform charges an extra fee (default false)

category.description: Optional fee category where the platform has one (the answer lists the ones available)

tools.name: compare_resale_platforms
tools.description: Rank resale marketplaces by what the seller keeps from the same sale price, using each platform's published fees. Compares the platforms that trade in one currency (EUR, GBP, USD, CAD or AUD), so no exchange rate is involved. Returns fees, payout and profit per platform, best first.

sale_price.description: Sale price, in the chosen currency

currency.description: Currency, which selects the platforms compared (default EUR)

item_cost.description: What you paid for the item (default 0)

shipping_paid.description: What you pay for the label (default 0)

tools.name: calculate_max_buy_price
tools.description: Given the price you expect to resell at, the marketplace and the profit you want to keep, return the most you can pay for the item after the platform's fees and your shipping. Pure arithmetic on the published fee schedule; it does not look up market prices (use check_vinted_item for that).

resale_price.description: Price you expect to sell at, in the platform's currency

platform.description: Marketplace you will sell on (default vinted-eu)

target_profit.description: Profit you want to keep on this item (default 0, which gives the break-even buy price)

shipping_paid.description: What you pay for the label (default 0)

tools.name: calculate_lot_profit
tools.description: For a job lot, bale or bundle bought to resell piece by piece: cost per piece, net per sale, how many pieces must sell to break even, and the profit at the expected sell-through rate and at 15 points below and above it.

pieces.description: Number of pieces in the lot

avg_sale_price.description: Average price you expect per piece sold

sell_rate_pct.description: Share of the pieces you expect to sell, in % (default 70)

fee_pct.description: Marketplace fee in % of the sale price (default 0, as for private sellers on Vinted)

inbound_shipping.description: Shipping you pay to receive the lot (default 0)

shipping_per_piece.description: Shipping you pay per piece sold (default 0)

other_cost_per_piece.description: Other cost per piece sold, such as packaging (default 0)

tools.name: compare_shipping_costs
tools.description: List what carriers charge to send one parcel between two countries (FR, UK, DE, ES, IT, US where we have verified rates), cheapest first, from the carriers' own published price pages with the date read. Covers Mondial Relay, Colissimo, Vinted Go, Evri, InPost, DHL, Hermes and USPS.

from.description: Country the parcel is sent from

size.description: Parcel size: S (35 × 25 × 8 cm), M (45 × 35 × 16 cm) or L (60 × 40 × 35 cm). Default S.
